name: Ouroboros Actuarial Field Investigator Vest
description: Ouroboros field investigators assess claims in person across all tiers of GLMZ, which means the uniform has to function in a Spire boardroom and on a Shelf flood plain within the same shift. The vest is a structured multi-pocket design in Ouroboros's signature deep charcoal with thin gold piping at the pocket edges. The outer fabric is a water-resistant ripstop that doesn't crease visibly, and the lining is a passive thermal layer rated for the harbor wind corridor. Every pocket is labeled with embossed Ouroboros iconography — the serpent-loop — and internal pockets are RFID-shielded for document security. The vest is designed to be worn over either a formal shirt or a base layer depending on context, with magnetic front closure that adjusts the silhouette significantly. A discreet emergency transmitter is sewn into the left-shoulder seam, company policy for any investigator working below Tier 3.
cultural_context: Ouroboros investigators are not universally welcomed — they show up when someone has made a claim or when Ouroboros suspects fraud. The vest is recognizable enough that its appearance in a neighborhood changes behavior. Some people are relieved; others disappear before the investigator reaches their door.
story_hooks: An investigator goes missing mid-field assignment in Tier 1; their vest's emergency transmitter was surgically removed before they disappeared, suggesting the assailants knew exactly what to look for.
A fraudulent Ouroboros investigator has been operating in Tier 2 using a near-perfect replica vest, collecting 'documentation fees' from residents unfamiliar with official Ouroboros procedure.

The RFID shielding in a batch of investigator vests is faulty in a specific way that allows external readers to capture document data — Ouroboros's internal security team is unsure whether it's a manufacturing error or deliberate.

physical_description.visual_profile: A structured, professional utility vest with sharp tailoring and deliberate authority. The silhouette reads as corporate—broad shoulders, defined waist, geometric pocket architecture. Worn over formal wear it looks boardroom-ready; layered over a base layer it becomes tactical. The deep charcoal creates a visual weight that commands respect without aggression. Gold piping traces each pocket like circuit paths, subtle but unmistakable branding.
physical_description.fit: Precision tailored through the torso with strategic dart placement. Sits snug across the shoulders and ribs, allowing unrestricted arm movement. The magnetic closure allows the front to be worn open (casual, approachable) or sealed tight (official, impenetrable). Length hits mid-hip, covering the waist without excess fabric.
physical_description.primary_material: Water-resistant ripstop nylon outer shell—technically military-grade but finished to look corporate. The ripstop weave is subtle, visible only under direct light. Interior is a dense thermal regulation fabric, passive and invisible to the wearer but engineered for temperature extremes.
physical_description.texture: Outer surface is smooth with a barely-perceptible grid texture from the ripstop weave. Pocket edges are reinforced with subtle binding. Gold piping is embossed rather than raised, creating tactile confirmation of authenticity. Lining is soft to the touch, almost brushed, preventing sweat adhesion.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep charcoal (almost black, but not quite—reads as authority gray). Accent piping in matte gold at every pocket edge and along the magnetic closure track. No other colors. The restraint is intentional; the vest speaks through absence.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic front closure (high-tech, silent, no fumbling). Invisible snap pockets at the waist for small items. Side seams include friction-fit retention for document sleeves. Every closure is designed to be soundless—no zips, no velcro, nothing that announces movement.
distinctive_features: Embossed Ouroboros serpent-loop on every external pocket flap—brand seal and anti-counterfeit measure
RFID-shielded internal document pockets (detectable only by touch—slightly thicker lining)
Discreet emergency transmitter sewn into left-shoulder seam (invisible, mass <5g, range 2km urban)
Gold piping follows pocket geometry like circuit traces
Thermal regulation lining rated for -8°C to +12°C differential
Ripstop material shows zero wrinkle memory after 8-hour wear cycles
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2 corporate uniform. Expensive enough to signal serious employment, not so luxe that it appears inaccessible. Ouroboros pays well for field investigators; this vest costs roughly 180 Φ retail, 280 Φ custom.
physical_description.cultural_context: The vest is a symbol of financial oversight and claim verification—the uniform of someone who arrives to determine if your story is true. Wearing it signals you work for one of GLMZ's largest insurance bodies. In Tier 1 spires, the vest opens doors. On the Shelves and in Tier 5 zones, it often closes them. The investigator is always an outsider, always suspect.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when issued, then maintained obsessively. Field investigators understand their appearance is their authority. Scuffs get buffed, stains get spot-cleaned, piping stays bright. After 2-3 years of hard use, a worn-in vest shows subtle creasing at the elbows and a slight patina on the gold piping, but never looks unprofessional. Worn vests are replaced under warranty.

image_prompt: A cyberpunk fashion photograph of an Ouroboros field investigator standing in a rain-slicked urban environment, streetlight reflecting off wet pavement. The model wears the deep charcoal ripstop vest with magnetic front sealed, revealing the gold piping detail at pocket edges, worn over a crisp white formal shirt. The vest's silhouette is sharp and authoritative. Left shoulder is visible, hinting at the hidden emergency transmitter. The backdrop is a mixed-tier GLMZ street—corporate signage bleeding into weathered residential architecture. Moody blue and amber lighting creates shadow across the vest's chest. Close detail shot shows the embossed Ouroboros serpent-loop on a pocket flap. Dark, serious, official. --ar 2:3 --v 6
